variants.name: Fotografía cinematográfica
variants.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished premium advertising still image for ComandPOS by GCODE restaurant software, vertical 4:5 composition. This is a local creative exploration, not a published advertisement. Reference image 1 is the previous advertising style: preserve brand navy/orange vocabulary but substantially elevate and vary the art direction, do not repeat its generic white bands and icon row. Reference image 2 is the authentic ComandPOS logo: reproduce its geometric G symbol, exact ComandPOS spelling with orange POS and by GCODE accurately; place it on a navy area for contrast, respect its proportions. Brand palette midnight navy #14233b, vivid orange #ff6b35, warm ivory. Communicate only verified features: recording orders and sending kitchen tickets. Main headline EXACT Spanish text: “DEL PEDIDO A COCINA”. Supporting text EXACT: “Gestiona pedidos y envía comandas con ComandPOS.” CTA EXACT: “Solicita tu demo”. Website EXACT: “comandpos.com”. Small but readable bottom footnote EXACT: “Escena ilustrativa · Equipos no incluidos”. Spell all text correctly, clean professional typography, strong mobile legibility, generous edge margins, intentional visual hierarchy, one core idea, no invented prices, statistics, certifications, testimonials, discounts or claims. No QR code, no watermarks, no mock social app frame. Do not invent a detailed product screenshot: any order tile is explicitly a simple illustrative ticket with only “Mesa 4” and “Sin cebolla”. Full finished ad, not a blank photo awaiting text. Distinct sophisticated visual narrative, depth and beautiful craft, not gratuitous decoration.
Art direction: Immersive editorial food and restaurant photography. Rich dark navy upper third integrates a dramatically large ivory headline, with a restrained orange rule. Dominican restaurant at evening service, candid Dominican waitress holding a tablet in natural three-quarter profile and chef plating mofongo at the pass, focused warm human interaction, subtle motion implied in background only, real skin and stainless-steel texture. Warm tungsten practical lights contrast with cool navy shadows; 50mm commercial photography, selective focus. Bold asymmetric magazine-quality art direction. A single restrained orange flow line visually connects the tablet to a small illustrative kitchen ticket, no floating holograms. Subject fills composition, no giant empty white zones. Brand footer restrained, orange CTA high contrast.
variants.note: Luz cálida, profundidad y una escena de servicio más envolvente.
